description: This file defines a SQL execution function and a string formatter class for pandas-on-Spark, including handling of SQL queries, parameter substitution, and integration with Spark sessions.

classes.name: PandasSQLStringFormatter
classes.description: A string formatter class that interprets pandas-on-Spark objects for SQL query string formatting.

methods.name: sql
methods.description: Executes a SQL query and returns a pandas-on-Spark DataFrame, supporting parameter substitution and integration with Spark sessions.

methods.name: PandasSQLStringFormatter.vformat
methods.description: Overrides string.Formatter.vformat to handle pandas-on-Spark objects during string formatting.

methods.name: PandasSQLStringFormatter.get_field
methods.description: Retrieves a field value and converts it into a SQL-compatible string if necessary.

methods.name: PandasSQLStringFormatter._convert_value
methods.description: Converts various pandas-on-Spark objects into SQL string representations.

methods.name: PandasSQLStringFormatter.clear
methods.description: Clears temporary views and references after query execution.
